"""CPU-only check of both finite states and the matched native control."""

from pathlib import Path

import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V152-relative-phase-v1')
previous = Path(read(root / 'plan-v1.json')['previous'])
path = root / 'checkpoints/train-step0250.pt'
oldpath = previous / 'checkpoints/train-step0250.pt'
state = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
old = torch.load(oldpath, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
assert state['step'] == old['step'] == 250
finite = 0
for arm, tensors in [('noisy-control', 12), ('relative-phase', 13)]:
    for key in ['models', 'emas']:
        assert len(state[key][arm]) == tensors
        assert all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in state[key][arm].values())
    assert len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state']) == tensors
    for values in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values():
        assert int(values['step']) == 250
        assert all(not torch.is_tensor(v) or torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values())
        finite += 1
for key in ['models', 'emas']:
    current, archived = state[key]['noisy-control'], old[key]['noisy-only']
    assert current.keys() == archived.keys()
    assert all(torch.equal(value, archived[name]) for name, value in current.items())
current, archived = state['optimizers']['noisy-control'], old['optimizers']['noisy-only']
assert current['param_groups'] == archived['param_groups']
assert current['state'].keys() == archived['state'].keys()
for number, values in current['state'].items():
    assert all(torch.equal(value, archived['state'][number][name])
               if torch.is_tensor(value) else value == archived['state'][number][name]
               for name, value in values.items())
assert finite == 25 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root / 'checkpoint250-audit-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-both-finite-states-and-exact-control-at250',
    'checkpoint': ref(path), 'control_checkpoint': ref(oldpath), 'step': 250,
    'finite_Adam_states': finite, 'control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact': True,
    'source': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0, 'CUDA_initialized': False,
    'scope': 'Both fresh states/EMAs and all25 optimizer states finite. Native raw/EMA/Adam exactly matches V151 noisy-only at250; quality unmeasured.'})
print('PASS: 25 finite Adam states; native raw/EMA/Adam exact V151 at250; no CUDA/forward')
